name: Chengdu Rainbow Appliance (Group) Shares Co., Ltd.
summary: Headquartered in Chengdu, China, Chengdu Rainbow Appliance (Group) Shares Co., Ltd. is a manufacturer and distributor specializing in two core areas: domestic flexible electric heating products and household hygiene insect control solutions. The company's diverse portfolio features popular items like electric blankets and hand warmers. For pest management, its offerings span electric mosquito liquid vaporizers, various types of mosquito coils (including electric versions), and a range of repellents and aerosol insecticides for both indoor and outdoor use.
